description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Ditto protocol adapter, including methods to retrieve provider class name and blocked header keys, as well as an inner enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: ProtocolConfig
classes.description: An interface providing methods to access protocol configuration settings, such as provider class name and blocked header keys, with an inner enum defining default configuration values.

methods.name: getProviderClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the provider of the Ditto protocol adapter.

methods.name: getBlockedHeaderKeys
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of header keys that should be ignored by Ditto.
